displayName: OCI-WSTG01-005: Metadata and Source Code Exposure
description:
Detects access to metadata files and source code repositories exposing implementation details

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_005", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%metadata%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%source%') AND "value" > 0
